### PRIVACY POLICY & TERMS

Welcome to Venner Photo Studio. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your booking information.

# 1. Information Collection
We collect details such as your name, email address, phone number, and event details when you submit an inquiry form or book a session with us. This information is exclusively used to coordinate photography sessions, process billing, and communicate with you.

# 2. Media Ownership & Usage
All photographic and motion materials captured by Venner Photo Studio remain the artistic property of the studio. Portfolios may be displayed on our official showcase channels for marketing and creative showcasing, unless mutually agreed otherwise in writing prior to the session.

# 3. Data Protection
We implement rigorous secure encryption and authentication protocols to safeguard your personal records and media metadata against unauthorized access or breaches.
